name: run_start
description: Start a run: one task with one intent, the unit a person reviews and reverts. Pass the runId to later write and query calls. Pass taskId to join a task another agent started. Call status once at the start of a session, and describe before your first query to see the resources you can use. If the guard has migrations to install, the result carries a GUARD_UPGRADE_AVAILABLE warning with nextSteps (the work goes on; the person upgrades when ready).

intent.description: Why this run exists, in a sentence a person can review.

taskId.description: A task shared with other agents. A new task is created when absent.

warnings.description: Planned (CONTRACT.md, Next steps): GUARD_UPGRADE_AVAILABLE when only non-breaking guard migrations are missing. Absent when empty.
